relationships.subject: suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: The recent approval of the NaV1.8-selective inhibitor suzetrigine for acute postoperative pain demonstrates the feasibility of highly selective peripheral sodium-channel inhibition

key_findings: NaV1.8-selective inhibition is promising for CIPN but NaV selectivity alone is unlikely to suffice given heterogeneous mechanisms and NaV1.7/1.8/1.9 redundancy.
Multimodal strategies combining NaV modulators with agents targeting oxidative stress, mitochondria, and immune activation are proposed.
